comments.value:
I like this idea in the way that if there’s an event going on, a moderator of the instance should be able to set the audience to be muted and the performers(s) to be the only ones allowed to talk. 

With that being said, maybe some type of in game private messaging as well.
I support this by way of giving groups the ability to add roles that can mod instances and other users of the group.
Not a bad idea, I think the new group system would be able to implement these permissions.
It’s almost like having a stream mod.

A good concept! Will need some consideration and careful planning, but this would make an interesting addition to provide more power in the hands of players. @{5cc8ef132dfd030ccc7c49c3|full_name}'s own reply here offers an interesting follow-up. ^^
It would be nice to have world creators manually assign friends as moderators for public instances for worlds they created via roles.
@{5f5498c5db18394df7d03464|full_name}: +1 to this. I can see Groups being a great way to manage this, and expect it's probably already part of the planned feature set.

I think this is a great idea, though, there would probably need to be a data change so things can be solved better. For example: There should be a flag for *which* moderation actions were done by who, or if it was done by a "moderator" and not "owner".

This way, the moderators can not undo or change moderation actions that the main user did. Obviously you should be careful who you pick as your moderators, but this would still prevent abuse or reduce accidents.

details:
Implement the ability to set specific users to moderate users for you specifically for your account.

Would be useful for streamers, live performers, stage speakers, or anything requiring public world moderation to keep the integrity of a performance or event.

For example: 

While a performer is performing, it is very common for troublesome users to interrupt the the performance (especially in public worlds). It usually begins with them yelling obscenities and being as loud as possible. Instead of having to stop the performance and block the user, another specified user can block or mute them for me so that there would be no interruption on my end / broadcast.
title: User Moderation for other accounts.
